privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.controller: Controller: {{ name }}, reachable at {{ email }} (postal address in the imprint).

s1.title: Login with Discord
s1.body: You log in with Discord (OAuth, only the “identify” permission). We receive your Discord ID, display name and avatar address – no email address and no password.

s2.title: Game data
s2.body: We store what is needed to play: characters, attributes, tactics, items, credits and their bookings, fights with replays, dungeon runs, teams and community memberships including roles.

s3.title: Chat activity
s3.body: For activity XP the Discord bot evaluates messages in memory only: length and a shortened hash to detect repetitions. Message texts are never stored. The hash stays in the cache for at most 10 minutes; only daily counters (number of messages, XP granted) are stored permanently.

s4.title: Cookies and local storage
s4.body: We only set technically necessary cookies: the login session (httpOnly) and briefly a security cookie during login. Your language choice is kept in your browser's storage. There is no tracking, no analytics, no advertising and no third-party fonts or scripts.

s5.title: Server logs and abuse protection
s5.body: Logs contain the method, path, status and time of a request – no IP addresses, cookies or contents. To prevent abuse we count requests per session or IP address for one minute in the cache.

s6.title: Legal bases and retention
s6.body: Processing serves to provide the game (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR) and to prevent abuse (Art. 6(1)(f)). Data is kept as long as your account exists; sessions expire after inactivity. Database backups are kept for at most 14 days.

s7.title: Your rights
s7.body: Under “Account” you can download all stored data as a file and delete your account yourself. This removes characters, items, sessions and memberships; in other players' replays you then appear as “Deleted player”, bookings remain anonymously. You also have the right to rectification, restriction, objection and to lodge a complaint with a data protection authority.

s8.title: Discord
s8.body: For login and the bot we use Discord (Discord Inc., USA); Discord's privacy policy applies in addition. TBCA is hosted by the operator of this instance.
